props.animation_script:
// =============================================================================

// Inferex - Chomp (dash + JB2A bite VFX + blood + violent shake). Bespoke.

// Inferex lunges to the target, a red creature-bite webm chomps down on it,

// blood spatters and the target sprite shakes violently. doneHook fires on the

// bite contact, with a monster SFX.

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.inferex.chomp";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Chomp]";

const BITE_URL = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Creature/Bite_01_Regular_Red_400x400.webm";

const CFG = {

lungeFrac: 0.60, lungeMs: 140, returnMs: 200,

biteSize: 0.55, biteDoneAtMs: 340, biteMaxMs: 1000, biteFadeMs: 200,

sfxBite: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Monster2.ogg", sfxBiteVol: 0.6,

bloodColor: 0x9E1B1B, bloodCount: 16, bloodSize: 0.02, bloodSpread: 0.16, bloodMs: 620, gravity: 0.10,

shakePx: 0.024, shakeMs: 420, endPadMs: 120, totalTimeoutMs: 8000,

};

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeInCubic = (t) => t*t*t;

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1-t,3);

const easeInOutCubic = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t+2,3)/2;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => { const raw = dur>0?Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/dur):1; try{fn(ease?ease(raw):raw,raw);}catch(_){} if(raw>=1){ticker.remove(step);resolve();} };

ticker.add(step);

});

}

function meshOf(tok) { return tok ? tok.mesh : null; }

function makeSprite(tok, faceSign) {

const m = meshOf(tok);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(m?.texture ?? PIXI.Texture.WHITE);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);

sp.width = Math.abs(m?.width ?? (tok?.w ?? 100));

sp.height = Math.abs(m?.height ?? (tok?.h ?? 100));

sp.angle = m?.angle ?? 0;

const sx = Math.sign(m?.scale?.x ?? 1) || 1, sy = Math.sign(m?.scale?.y ?? 1) || 1;

sp.scale.x = Math.abs(sp.scale.x) * sx * (faceSign || 1);

sp.scale.y = Math.abs(sp.scale.y) * sy;

return sp;

}

function makeHider(tok) {

const m = meshOf(tok); let on=false,tR=true,mR=true;

const guard = () => { if (!tok) return; tok.renderable = false; if (m) m.renderable = false; };

return { start(){ if(!tok||on)return; on=true; tR=tok.renderable??true; mR=m?.renderable??true; ticker.add(guard); },

restore(){ if(!tok||!on)return; ticker.remove(guard); tok.renderable=tR; if(m)m.renderable=mR; try{tok.renderFlags.set({refreshVisibility:true,refreshMesh:true,refreshState:true});}catch(_){} on=false; } };

}

function dotTexture(hex) {

const s = 64; const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = s;

const g = cv.getContext("2d");

const col = "#" + (hex >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(6, "0").slice(-6);

const grd = g.createRadialGradient(s/2, s/2, 0, s/2, s/2, s/2);

grd.addColorStop(0, col); grd.addColorStop(0.55, col); grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

g.fillStyle = grd; g.beginPath(); g.arc(s/2, s/2, s/2, 0, Math.PI*2); g.fill();

return PIXI.Texture.from(cv);

}

function playSfx(url, vol) {

if (!url) return;

try { const a = new Audio(url); a.volume = (vol == null ? 0.6 : vol); a.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (_) {}

}

async function loadVideo(url) {

const vid = document.createElement("video");

try { vid.crossOrigin = "anonymous"; } catch (_) {}

vid.src = url; vid.muted = true; vid.loop = false; vid.playsInline = true; vid.preload = "auto";

await new Promise((res) => { let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; vid.addEventListener("loadeddata",go,{once:true}); vid.addEventListener("error",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go,1500); });

return vid;

}

try {

const home = caster ? { x: caster.center.x, y: caster.center.y } : { x: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.3*W,0.5*H)).x, y: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.3*W,0.5*H)).y };

const tgtTok = targetTokens[0] || null;

const tgt = tgtTok ? { x: tgtTok.center.x, y: tgtTok.center.y } : { x: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.7*W,0.5*H)).x, y: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.7*W,0.5*H)).y };

const dx = tgt.x-home.x, dy = tgt.y-home.y;

const faceSign = (tgt.x < home.x) ? -1 : 1;

const apex = { x: home.x + dx*cfg.lungeFrac, y: home.y + dy*cfg.lungeFrac };

const bloodTex = dotTexture(cfg.bloodColor);

// 1) dash in

const casterHide = makeHider(caster); casterHide.start();

const clone = makeSprite(caster, faceSign);

clone.x = home.x; clone.y = home.y; clone.zIndex = 9000;

stage.addChild(clone); spawned.push(clone);

await tween((p)=>{ clone.x=home.x+(apex.x-home.x)*p; clone.y=home.y+(apex.y-home.y)*p; }, cfg.lungeMs, easeInCubic);

// 2) bite VFX chomps down on the target

// hide the real target under a clone FIRST so the bite VFX can render on top

// of the token image (the clone sits below the webm's zIndex).

const tgtHide = makeHider(tgtTok); let tgtClone = null;

if (tgtTok) {

tgtHide.start();

tgtClone = makeSprite(tgtTok, 1);

tgtClone.x = tgt.x; tgtClone.y = tgt.y; tgtClone.zIndex = 8500;

stage.addChild(tgtClone); spawned.push(tgtClone);

}

const bvid = await loadVideo(A.bite);

const btex = PIXI.Texture.from(bvid);

const bnat = btex.width || btex.orig?.width || 400;

const bite = new PIXI.Sprite(btex);

bite.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5); bite.x = tgt.x; bite.y = tgt.y; bite.zIndex = 9300; // above target + caster clones

bite.scale.set(hPx(cfg.biteSize) / bnat);

stage.addChild(bite); spawned.push(bite);

try { bvid.currentTime = 0; await bvid.play(); } catch (_) {}

// 3) BITE contact: done + monster sfx + blood + violent shake

await waitMs(cfg.biteDoneAtMs);

fireDone({ ok: true });

playSfx(cfg.sfxBite, cfg.sfxBiteVol);

const shakeAmp = hPx(cfg.shakePx);

const shake = tween((p)=>{ if(!tgtClone)return; const d=(1-p)*shakeAmp; tgtClone.x=tgt.x+(Math.random()*2-1)*d; tgtClone.y=tgt.y+(Math.random()*2-1)*d; }, cfg.shakeMs, null).then(()=>{ if(tgtClone){tgtClone.x=tgt.x;tgtClone.y=tgt.y;} });

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.bloodCount; i++) {

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(bloodTex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5); sp.zIndex = 9060;

const sz = hPx(cfg.bloodSize)*(0.5+Math.random()); sp.width=sp.height=sz; sp.tint = cfg.bloodColor;

sp.x = tgt.x; sp.y = tgt.y; stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, spd = hPx(cfg.bloodSpread)*(0.4+Math.random());

const vx = Math.cos(a)*spd, vy = Math.sin(a)*spd - hPx(0.03);

tween((p)=>{ sp.x=tgt.x+vx*p; sp.y=tgt.y+vy*p+hPx(cfg.gravity)*p*p; sp.alpha=1-p*p; sp.scale.set(1-0.4*p); }, cfg.bloodMs*(0.7+Math.random()*0.5), easeOutCubic).then(()=>destroyObj(sp));

}

// let the bite webm finish, then fade it out

await new Promise((res)=>{ let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; bvid.addEventListener("ended",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go, cfg.biteMaxMs || 1000); });

await tween((p)=>{ bite.alpha = 1-p; }, cfg.biteFadeMs || 200, easeOutCubic);

destroyObj(bite);

try { bvid.pause(); bvid.removeAttribute("src"); bvid.load(); } catch (_) {}

await shake;

if (tgtTok) tgtHide.restore();

// 4) recoil home

clone.scale.x = Math.abs(clone.scale.x) * (Math.sign(clone.scale.x)||1) * ((home.x < apex.x) ? -1 : 1);

await tween((p)=>{ clone.x=apex.x+(home.x-apex.x)*p; clone.y=apex.y+(home.y-apex.y)*p; }, cfg.returnMs, easeInOutCubic);

destroyObj(clone);

casterHide.restore();

await waitMs(cfg.endPadMs);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][Chomp]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

cleanupAll();

}

`;

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG, assets: { bite: BITE_URL } },

meta: { source: "Chomp" },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, "pseudo non-OK / timeout", result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();

// =============================================================================

// Flamethrower (generic) - AoE fire cone-breath webm, reused across monsters.

// Ported verbatim from Wandering Flame's Flamethrower. Caster dashes to mid-scene,

// breathes a JB2A fire cone rotated toward the target centroid; doneHook fires

// when the webm ends so BD applies damage on the flame; webm finishes as tail.

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Flamethrower]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.gen.flamethrower";

const CONE_URL = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Template/Cone/Breath_Weapon/BreathWeapon_Fire01_Regular_Orange_30ft_Cone_Burst_600x600.webm";

const CFG = {

midX: 0.5,

midY: 0.5,

dashMs: 380,

dashBackMs: 320,

anchorX: 0.02,

reach: 1.15,

minLen: 0.30,

maxLen: 0.95,

maxMs: 9000,

fadeMs: 260,

endPadMs: 120,

totalTimeoutMs: 12000,

sfxBreath: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Fire1.ogg",

sfxBreathVol: 0.6,

};

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) {

try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; }

}

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) {

const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t;

}

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS))

for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const A = ctx.params.assets;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const S2W = (fx, fy) => WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(fx * W, fy * H));

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInOutCubic = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => {

const raw = dur > 0 ? Math.min(1, (performance.now() - t0) / dur) : 1;

try { fn(ease ? ease(raw) : raw, raw); } catch (_) {}

if (raw >= 1) { ticker.remove(step); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(step);

});

}

const baseMesh = caster ? caster.mesh : null;

const baseSignX = Math.sign(baseMesh?.scale?.x ?? 1) || 1;

const baseSignY = Math.sign(baseMesh?.scale?.y ?? 1) || 1;

function makeCasterSprite(faceSign) {

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(baseMesh?.texture ?? PIXI.Texture.WHITE);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);

sp.width = Math.abs(baseMesh?.width ?? (caster?.w ?? 100));

sp.height = Math.abs(baseMesh?.height ?? (caster?.h ?? 100));

sp.angle = baseMesh?.angle ?? 0;

sp.scale.x = Math.abs(sp.scale.x) * baseSignX * (faceSign || 1);

sp.scale.y = Math.abs(sp.scale.y) * baseSignY;

return sp;

}

let hiding = false, origTokR = true, origMeshR = true;

function hideGuard() { if (!caster) return; caster.renderable = false; if (baseMesh) baseMesh.renderable = false; }

function startHide() {

if (!caster || hiding) return;

hiding = true; origTokR = caster.renderable ?? true; origMeshR = baseMesh?.renderable ?? true;

ticker.add(hideGuard);

}

function restoreCaster() {

if (!caster || !hiding) return;

ticker.remove(hideGuard);

caster.renderable = origTokR; if (baseMesh) baseMesh.renderable = origMeshR;

try { caster.renderFlags.set({ refreshVisibility: true, refreshMesh: true, refreshState: true }); } catch (_) {}

hiding = false;

}

function centroid(toks, fx, fy) {

if (toks && toks.length) {

let sx = 0, sy = 0;

for (const t of toks) { sx += t.center.x; sy += t.center.y; }

return { x: sx / toks.length, y: sy / toks.length };

}

const q = S2W(fx, fy); return { x: q.x, y: q.y };

}

async function loadVideo(url) {

const vid = document.createElement("video");

try { vid.crossOrigin = "anonymous"; } catch (_) {}

vid.src = url; vid.muted = true; vid.loop = false; vid.playsInline = true; vid.preload = "auto";

await new Promise((res) => {

let done = false; const go = () => { if (done) return; done = true; res(); };

vid.addEventListener("loadeddata", go, { once: true });

vid.addEventListener("error", go, { once: true });

setTimeout(go, 1500);

});

return vid;

}

function playSfx(url, vol) {

if (!url) return;

try { const a = new Audio(url); a.volume = (vol == null ? 0.6 : vol); a.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (_) {}

}

try {

const home = caster ? { x: caster.center.x, y: caster.center.y } : (function () { const q = S2W(0.3, 0.5); return { x: q.x, y: q.y }; })();

const midP = S2W(cfg.midX, cfg.midY);

const mid = { x: midP.x, y: midP.y };

const end = centroid(targetTokens, 0.7, 0.5);

startHide();

const clone = makeCasterSprite((mid.x < home.x) ? -1 : 1);

clone.x = home.x; clone.y = home.y; clone.zIndex = 9000;

stage.addChild(clone); spawned.push(clone);

await tween((p) => { clone.x = home.x + (mid.x - home.x) * p; clone.y = home.y + (mid.y - home.y) * p; }, cfg.dashMs, easeInOutCubic);

clone.x = mid.x; clone.y = mid.y;

clone.scale.x = Math.abs(clone.scale.x) * baseSignX * ((end.x < mid.x) ? -1 : 1);

const ang = Math.atan2(end.y - mid.y, end.x - mid.x);

const dist = Math.hypot(end.x - mid.x, end.y - mid.y);

const desiredLen = Math.max(hPx(cfg.minLen), Math.min(hPx(cfg.maxLen), dist * cfg.reach));

const vid = await loadVideo(A.cone);

const tex = PIXI.Texture.from(vid);

const nativeW = tex.width || tex.orig?.width || 600;

const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

spr.anchor.set(cfg.anchorX, 0.5);

spr.x = mid.x; spr.y = mid.y;

spr.rotation = ang;

spr.scale.set(desiredLen / nativeW);

spr.zIndex = 8999;

stage.addChild(spr); spawned.push(spr);

try { vid.currentTime = 0; await vid.play(); } catch (_) {}

playSfx(cfg.sfxBreath, cfg.sfxBreathVol); // fire whoosh as the cone breathes

await new Promise((res) => {

let done = false; const go = () => { if (done) return; done = true; res(); };

vid.addEventListener("ended", go, { once: true });

setTimeout(go, cfg.maxMs);

});

fireDone({ ok: true });

await tween((p) => { spr.alpha = 1 - p; }, cfg.fadeMs, easeOutCubic);

destroyObj(spr);

try { vid.pause(); vid.removeAttribute("src"); vid.load(); } catch (_) {}

clone.scale.x = Math.abs(clone.scale.x) * baseSignX * ((home.x < mid.x) ? -1 : 1);

await tween((p) => { clone.x = mid.x + (home.x - mid.x) * p; clone.y = mid.y + (home.y - mid.y) * p; }, cfg.dashBackMs, easeInOutCubic);

destroyObj(clone);

restoreCaster();

await waitMs(cfg.endPadMs);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][Flamethrower]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

restoreCaster();

cleanupAll();

}

`;

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG, assets: { cone: CONE_URL } },

meta: { source: "Flamethrower" },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, "pseudo non-OK / timeout", result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();

props.animation_script:
// =============================================================================

// Inferex - Blast Breath (charged fireball). Bespoke, pure PIXI.

// Dim the scene -> fire energy gathers at the caster's muzzle (target side) ->

// a fireball launches at the target -> a large DOM explosion (core + shockwave

// ring + embers) with screenshake -> undim + cleanup. doneHook fires on impact.

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.inferex.blastbreath";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][BlastBreath]";

const CFG = {

dimAlpha: 0.5, dimMs: 300, undimMs: 420,

fireColor: 0xFF7A20, coreColor: 0xFFF0C0,

gatherR: 0.10, gatherCount: 22, gatherSize: 0.022, gatherMs: 520, gatherStagger: 8,

chargeHoldMs: 120,

ballSize: 0.09, travelMs: 340, trailEveryMs: 14, trailFadeMs: 240,

explodeSize: 0.5, ringMax: 0.42, ringMs: 520,

emberCount: 22, emberSize: 0.024, emberSpread: 0.26, emberMs: 640,

shakeMs: 560, shakePx: 9, holdMs: 160, endPadMs: 160, totalTimeoutMs: 11000,

sfxCharge: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/ChargingA.wav", sfxChargeVol: 0.6,

sfxLaunch: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/FireBolt.ogg", sfxLaunchVol: 0.6,

};

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const S2W = (fx, fy) => WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(fx * W, fy * H));

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeInCubic = (t) => t*t*t;

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1-t,3);

const easeInQuad = (t) => t*t;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => { const raw = dur>0?Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/dur):1; try{fn(ease?ease(raw):raw,raw);}catch(_){} if(raw>=1){ticker.remove(step);resolve();} };

ticker.add(step);

});

}

function screenShake(ms, px) {

try {

const view = canvas.app.view;

if (!document.getElementById("oni-shake-kf")) {

const st = document.createElement("style"); st.id = "oni-shake-kf";

st.textContent = "@keyframes oniShake{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}15%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px," + px + "px)}30%{transform:translate(" + px + "px,-" + px + "px)}45%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px,-" + px + "px)}60%{transform:translate(" + px + "px," + px + "px)}75%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px,0)}} .oni-shaking{animation:oniShake 0.42s linear}";

document.head.appendChild(st);

}

view.classList.remove("oni-shaking"); void view.offsetWidth; view.classList.add("oni-shaking");

setTimeout(() => { try { view.classList.remove("oni-shaking"); } catch(_){} }, ms);

} catch (_) {}

}

function dotTexture(hex) {

const s = 64; const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = s;

const g = cv.getContext("2d");

const col = "#" + (hex >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(6, "0").slice(-6);

const grd = g.createRadialGradient(s/2, s/2, 0, s/2, s/2, s/2);

grd.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff"); grd.addColorStop(0.4, col); grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

g.fillStyle = grd; g.beginPath(); g.arc(s/2, s/2, s/2, 0, Math.PI*2); g.fill();

return PIXI.Texture.from(cv);

}

function fullRect(color, alpha, z) {

const a = S2W(-0.1,-0.1), b = S2W(1.1,1.1);

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.beginFill(color, 1).drawRect(a.x, a.y, b.x-a.x, b.y-a.y).endFill();

g.alpha = alpha; g.zIndex = z;

return g;

}

function playSfx(url, vol) {

if (!url) return;

try { const a = new Audio(url); a.volume = (vol == null ? 0.6 : vol); a.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (_) {}

}

try {

const home = caster ? { x: caster.center.x, y: caster.center.y } : { x: S2W(0.3,0.5).x, y: S2W(0.3,0.5).y };

const tgtTok = targetTokens[0] || null;

const tgt = tgtTok ? { x: tgtTok.center.x, y: tgtTok.center.y } : { x: S2W(0.7,0.5).x, y: S2W(0.7,0.5).y };

const dirx = tgt.x-home.x, diry = tgt.y-home.y; const dl = Math.hypot(dirx,diry) || 1;

const ux = dirx/dl, uy = diry/dl;

const muzzleR = caster ? Math.max(caster.w, caster.h)*0.55 : hPx(0.06);

const muzzle = { x: home.x + ux*muzzleR, y: home.y + uy*muzzleR };

const fireTex = dotTexture(cfg.fireColor);

const coreTex = dotTexture(cfg.coreColor);

// 1) dim

const dim = fullRect(0x000000, 0, 7000);

stage.addChild(dim); spawned.push(dim);

await tween((p)=>{ dim.alpha = cfg.dimAlpha*p; }, cfg.dimMs, easeOutCubic);

// 2) energy gathers at the muzzle

playSfx(cfg.sfxCharge, cfg.sfxChargeVol);

const gR = hPx(cfg.gatherR);

const gathers = [];

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.gatherCount; i++) {

const ang = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, r = gR*(0.7+Math.random()*0.6);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(fireTex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5); sp.zIndex = 7300; sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; sp.tint = cfg.fireColor;

const sz = hPx(cfg.gatherSize)*(0.6+Math.random()); sp.width=sp.height=sz;

sp.x = muzzle.x+Math.cos(ang)*r; sp.y = muzzle.y+Math.sin(ang)*r; sp.alpha = 0;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp); gathers.push({sp, ox:sp.x, oy:sp.y});

}

// growing charge core

const charge = new PIXI.Sprite(coreTex);

charge.anchor.set(0.5); charge.zIndex = 7350; charge.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; charge.tint = cfg.coreColor;

charge.x = muzzle.x; charge.y = muzzle.y; charge.width = charge.height = 0; charge.alpha = 0;

stage.addChild(charge); spawned.push(charge);

const gatherAnim = Promise.all(gathers.map(({sp,ox,oy},i)=>(async()=>{

await waitMs(i*cfg.gatherStagger);

await tween((p)=>{ sp.x=ox+(muzzle.x-ox)*p; sp.y=oy+(muzzle.y-oy)*p; sp.alpha=Math.sin(p*Math.PI); sp.scale.set(1-0.3*p); }, cfg.gatherMs, easeInCubic);

destroyObj(sp);

})()));

tween((p)=>{ const s=hPx(cfg.ballSize)*p; charge.width=charge.height=s; charge.alpha=p; }, cfg.gatherMs, easeInQuad);

await Promise.race([gatherAnim, waitMs(cfg.gatherMs+80)]);

await waitMs(cfg.chargeHoldMs);

// 3) fireball launches at the target

playSfx(cfg.sfxLaunch, cfg.sfxLaunchVol);

const ball = new PIXI.Sprite(coreTex);

ball.anchor.set(0.5); ball.zIndex = 8000; ball.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; ball.tint = cfg.coreColor;

const bs = hPx(cfg.ballSize); ball.width = ball.height = bs;

ball.x = muzzle.x; ball.y = muzzle.y;

stage.addChild(ball); spawned.push(ball);

destroyObj(charge);

let lastTrail = 0;

await tween((p)=>{

ball.x = muzzle.x + (tgt.x-muzzle.x)*p; ball.y = muzzle.y + (tgt.y-muzzle.y)*p;

const now = performance.now();

if (now-lastTrail > cfg.trailEveryMs) {

lastTrail = now;

const tr = new PIXI.Sprite(fireTex);

tr.anchor.set(0.5); tr.zIndex = 7990; tr.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; tr.tint = cfg.fireColor;

tr.width = tr.height = bs*0.9; tr.x = ball.x; tr.y = ball.y;

stage.addChild(tr); spawned.push(tr);

tween((q)=>{ tr.alpha=1-q; tr.scale.set(1-0.5*q); }, cfg.trailFadeMs, easeOutCubic).then(()=>destroyObj(tr));

}

}, cfg.travelMs, easeInQuad);

destroyObj(ball);

// 4) EXPLOSION at target + screenshake

fireDone({ ok: true });

screenShake(cfg.shakeMs, cfg.shakePx);

const core = new PIXI.Sprite(coreTex);

core.anchor.set(0.5); core.zIndex = 9000; core.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; core.tint = cfg.coreColor;

core.x = tgt.x; core.y = tgt.y; core.width = core.height = bs;

stage.addChild(core); spawned.push(core);

const eSize = hPx(cfg.explodeSize);

tween((p)=>{ core.width=core.height=bs+(eSize-bs)*p; core.alpha=1-p; core.tint = (p<0.4?cfg.coreColor:cfg.fireColor); }, 420, easeOutCubic).then(()=>destroyObj(core));

const ring = new PIXI.Graphics(); ring.zIndex = 8990; ring.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

stage.addChild(ring); spawned.push(ring);

const ringMax = hPx(cfg.ringMax);

tween((p)=>{ ring.clear(); ring.lineStyle(wLen(6)*(1-p)+wLen(2), cfg.fireColor, (1-p)); ring.drawCircle(tgt.x, tgt.y, ringMax*p); }, cfg.ringMs, easeOutCubic).then(()=>destroyObj(ring));

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.emberCount; i++) {

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(fireTex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5); sp.zIndex = 9010; sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; sp.tint = cfg.fireColor;

const sz = hPx(cfg.emberSize)*(0.5+Math.random()); sp.width=sp.height=sz;

sp.x = tgt.x; sp.y = tgt.y; stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, spd = hPx(cfg.emberSpread)*(0.4+Math.random());

const vx = Math.cos(a)*spd, vy = Math.sin(a)*spd;

tween((p)=>{ sp.x=tgt.x+vx*p; sp.y=tgt.y+vy*p+hPx(0.06)*p*p; sp.alpha=1-p; sp.scale.set(1-0.5*p); }, cfg.emberMs*(0.7+Math.random()*0.5), easeOutCubic).then(()=>destroyObj(sp));

}

await waitMs(cfg.holdMs + cfg.ringMs);

// 5) undim + cleanup

await tween((p)=>{ dim.alpha = cfg.dimAlpha*(1-p); }, cfg.undimMs, easeOutCubic);

await waitMs(cfg.endPadMs);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][BlastBreath]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

cleanupAll();

}

`;

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

meta: { source: "Blast Breath" },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, "pseudo non-OK / timeout", result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();
